summary: Adds a /download endpoint that serves files from the uploads directory. Changes the dev server to bind all interfaces with debug mode on.

findings.title: Path traversal in download endpoint
findings.problem: The download handler joins the request's name argument onto UPLOAD_DIR without any check. A name like ../../etc/passwd or an absolute path like /etc/passwd escapes the uploads directory.
findings.consequence: Any caller can read any file the server process can read. This includes secrets, config files and source code.
findings.fix: Resolve the joined path and reject it unless it lies under UPLOAD_DIR. Alternatively, serve the file with flask.send_from_directory, which applies safe_join.

findings.title: Debugger exposed on all interfaces
findings.problem: The main block now runs the app with debug=True and binds it to 0.0.0.0. Before this change, the main block bound only to 127.0.0.1 without debug.
findings.consequence: Anyone on the network can reach the interactive Werkzeug debugger. The debugger can run arbitrary code and leaks tracebacks.
findings.fix: Keep the bind on 127.0.0.1 and turn debug off. Alternatively, read both settings from environment variables.

findings.title: New download endpoint has no test
findings.problem: The repository has no test that exercises the new download endpoint. No test covers the missing-file or traversal cases.
findings.consequence: A regression in path handling would ship unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid file, a missing file and a traversal attempt.

dropped.reason: The debug finding already covers this host binding, because the exposed debugger is what makes the binding harmful. One finding per problem.
